3-Tier Pricing Ladder Mastery: The portfolio establishes a disciplined tiered architecture: Joint Guard (Base) at 200 LC captures mass volume; Joint Guard Plus at 400 LC addresses mid-tier patients; and Joint Guard Ultra at 650 LC commands premium margins. Ultra successfully executed an April price increase (+8.3% from 600 to 650 LC) while expanding monthly revenue to a record 22.13M LC in May!
⚠️
Wholesaler Order Volatility Diagnostic: The franchise displays severe bi-monthly "sawtooth" order spikes (e.g. Ultra May +88% to 22.1M LC, June -52% to 10.5M LC; Base June +653% to 9.1M LC, July -81% to 1.7M LC). This reflects wholesale distributor quota-loading rather than organic patient demand. Priority: institute distributor rolling order agreements and pharmacy sell-out incentives.

🚀 Strategic Commercial Action Plan for Brand Managers & Sales Force

Brand Growth Roadmap
Strategic Pillar Diagnostic Finding Root Cause & Commercial Risk Actionable Recommendation Target KPI
1. Demand Smoothing & Wholesaler Discipline Severe bi-monthly swings: Ultra ranged from 7.0M (Mar) to 22.1M (May); Base swung +653% in June to 9.1M, then dropped to 1.7M in July. Wholesaler quarterly quota-loading, distributor speculative purchasing, and intermittent batch deliveries. Establish quarterly rolling supply contracts with Eva/Ibn Sina/Sofico; shift rep incentives to pharmacy sell-out. MoM Variance < 20%
2. Ultra Premium Defense & Margin Preservation Ultra successfully passed an April price increase (600 → 650 LC) with record sales following in May (22.1M LC). Doctor prescription loyalty remains strong. Ultra holds #9 market-wide, surpassing Moventor Advance (100.0M LC). Protect 650 LC price point; avoid dilutive trade discounts; emphasize clinical superiority in severe OA. Realized Price ≥ 645 LC
3. Repositioning Joint Guard Plus Plus accounts for only 11.6% of franchise value (17.4M LC) and experiences erratic performance (1.2M – 4.3M LC). Doctor confusion regarding differentiation between Base and Ultra; under-detailed in orthopedic clinics. Target Plus (400 LC) for active lifestyle / mild OA patients who need more than Base (200 LC) but cannot afford Ultra (650 LC). Scale to 20% Franchise Mix
4. Portfolio Umbrella Co-Detailing Base surged to 45.5k units in June when reps focused on volume, showing strong latent demand. Medical reps detail SKUs in silos depending on monthly bonus schemes rather than presenting the full patient continuum. Structure medical rep KPIs around 'Joint Guard Franchise Target', bundling detailing aids for mild, moderate, and severe OA. Market Share 6.05% → 7.50%

Classifies brands into 4 strategic quadrants based on Market Share % (X-axis) and Growth Rate % vs Market (Y-axis):

⭐ STARS (High Share / High Growth) 0
Outperforming market with commanding share. Prioritize commercial investment & defense.
❓ QUESTION MARKS (Low Share / High Growth) 0
Fast-growing challenger brands. Potential future Stars; evaluate scaling opportunities.
🐄 CASH COWS (High Share / Mature Growth) 0
Established volume drivers with steady or slower growth. Maximize profitability & cash flow.
🛑 DOGS (Low Share / Underperforming) 0
Small market presence and trailing market growth. Review positioning, rationalization, or divestment.
